change.notes: One reviewed 023 extension adds hash-only Local Node credentials, two indexes, durable cancel_requested_at, the confirmed Knowledge API embedding-migration privilege sets, Knowledge Worker pending-progress SELECT and batch-poller SELECT/UPDATE, and only column-scoped UPDATE on document_versions.change_type and metadata for publication state and special-source provenance. The Worker still has no table UPDATE and no UPDATE on content, content_hash, document_id, version_number, or title. It also changes only SECURITY DEFINER and the fixed search_path on the two exact existing Assistant runtime functions whose frozen bodies perform owner-controlled writes. Gateway receives no direct INSERT rights on their protected tables. The functions retain exact source bodies, owner, and EXECUTE ACLs. No DELETE is added to the first three embedding tables, no API INSERT/UPDATE is added to progress, and API batch-table rights remain unchanged. Frozen 001-022 and the verified channel fingerprint remain unchanged. Root review and isolated own-role acceptance are required before activation.
